# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — teach the grading contract (re-run on hidden inputs), harden literals + type + verify
- Changes I made (edit → file → cluster):
  1. prompt.md — NEW "YOUR CODE IS RE-RUN ON HIDDEN INPUTS" block (compute from data; no hardcoded
     values/row-range; no copied sample tab; detect real extent, preview is truncated). Cluster #1
     overfit-to-input-1 / assumed-extent (38332, 5192, 51359, 450-9, 110-2, +55931/59667/30709).
  2. prompt.md — replaced weak "prefer literals" with a NARROW formula rule: ordinary scalar formulas
     (SUM/SUMIF/INDEX-MATCH/VLOOKUP/WORKDAY/SUMPRODUCT) stay allowed (they recalc fine); ONLY
     spill/dynamic-array (_xlfn.*, TEXTJOIN-over-array, FILTER/SORT/UNIQUE/SEQUENCE) + volatile
     (RANDBETWEEN/NOW/TODAY) → compute in Python. Cluster #2 formula-not-value: clean fix for 47741,
     partial for 56996. (53367/59743 use ordinary funcs → reclassified as logic, not formula.)
     NOTE: deliberately NOT a global literals ban — memory + source show passing 52021/46897/55060/
     55667/58109 rely on ordinary formulas recalculating; a ban would regress them.
  3. prompt.md — NEW "MATCH THE EXPECTED DATA TYPE" rule, verb-conditioned: convert/parse→real
     date/number; split/extract/copy→keep text; don't leave cells blank on failed lookup. Cluster #4
     date type-mismatch (50630, 51958) + coverage blanks (55931, 59667).
  4. task_template.md — rewrote verify step 3 into a mandatory pre-finish CHECKLIST (value+type per
     cell must be concrete not a formula string; non-empty COUNT vs range size; nothing outside range).
     Cluster #3 coverage under-fill (55931, 59667, 56637) — makes coverage/value a precondition.
- Expected effect + why safe: all four are ADDITIVE knowledge/structure grounded in the confirmed
  grading contract (adapter replays code on hidden inputs; evaluation compares by exact type after
  transform; LibreOffice recalc). The 25 passing tasks already generalize (passed all 3 hidden cases),
  already prefer literals, and already produce correct in-range output — so these reinforce their
  behavior and change nothing they do. BOUNDED blast radius. Type rule is verb-conditioned + numeric
  strings coerce, so only date tasks are actually at stake.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none — first iteration after seed (LEDGER/RUNMAP empty).
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters NOT cracked: genuine logic-misreads of ambiguous multi-step specs (39046, 3911,
  57090, 59259, 325-44, CF_11072, 11842, 353-29, 30709) and 57232's inconsistent per-cell GT types —
  not prose-fixable without hardcoding answers (would overfit/fail the held-out gate). #1/#3 give the
  full-coverage-but-wrong-value ones (11842, 353-29, 325-44) a better shot but the interpretation gap
  remains.
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration).
- Focus next iteration: read this iteration's RESULT; if the re-run/literals/type knowledge landed,
  the remaining ceiling is the logic-misread cluster — consider a worked example of "compute-from-data"
  for a multi-step aggregation, or (if a decision-rule pattern emerges) a narrowing example. Do NOT
  re-hardcode any task answer.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.560 Δ=+0.060 · fixed={353-29, 38332, 47741, 51958, CF_11072} · broke={50051, 58147}.
<!-- cand_0001: ACCEPTED val=0.560 Δ=+0.060 -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — repair cand_0001's 2 regressions + ship 5 new prose-fixable clusters
- Changes I made (1 line/edit; file + cluster):
  1. prompt.md formula block — split into SAFE-to-keep vs MUST-literalize; legacy CSE array formulas
     (SMALL(IF()), MAX(IF()), array INDEX/MATCH) explicitly SAFE, `_xlfn.` prefix is the tell for the
     modern spill funcs. REPAIRS regression 50051 (agent had reimplemented SMALL(IF()) as divergent literals).
  2. prompt.md formula block — new MUST-literalize clause: `<>""`/`=""` blank-tests, boolean-returning
     formulas, boolean SUMPRODUCT-over-text → compute literal; don't carry a broken `IF(…,"")` guard. Cluster 59743 (+53367).
  3. task_template.md verify step3 formula-check — aligned to #1/#2 (legacy arrays kept; _xlfn./volatile/
     blank-test/boolean → literal; split piece stays text).
  4. task_template.md verify step3 count-check — count what formulas EVALUATE to, not formula strings;
     a `""`-branch cell is EMPTY after recalc. Cluster 56637 (counted 146 strings, recalc left 91).
  5. task_template.md verify step3 outside-range-check — compare VALUES not openpyxl representation;
     benign re-serialization is fine; BAN hand-editing xlsx XML/zip. REPAIRS regression 58147 (XML surgery
     broke recalc); also removes the same trigger in 59667/56427.
  6. prompt.md save line — reinforce normal `wb.save`; no XML/zip hand-editing. Supports #5.
  7. prompt.md type block — numeric answer range needs a real number in every cell; don't invent a text
     sentinel ("New"/"N/A") unless the instruction explicitly permits a token. Cluster 55931 (wrote "New" → str-where-int).
  8. prompt.md type block — worked SPLIT/EXTRACT example: extracted pieces stay TEXT even if date-looking /
     even if the instruction names the year. Cluster 50630 + 325-44.
  9. prompt.md re-run block — COMPUTE AND OVERWRITE every answer cell; don't skip a pre-filled cell. Cluster 5192 (kept demo value).
- Expected effect + why safe: edits 1 & 5 recover cand_0001's two broken tasks (50051, 58147) by
  NARROWING the literalize set and RELAXING the outside-range check to values — both strictly reduce the
  behavior that caused the regression, and no passing task literalizes a legacy array or hand-edits XML.
  47741 (fixed last iter) uses `_xlfn.TEXTJOIN` so stays literalized. Edits 2/4/7/9 are additive/narrowing
  checks that passing tasks already satisfy (they fill fully, write numbers, overwrite cells). Edit 8 is a
  worked example reinforcing the existing verb-conditioned type rule; convert-tasks (51958) unaffected.
- Building on prior RESULTS: built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, fixed 353-29/38332/47741/51958/CF_11072). Kept
  all its rules; REPAIRED its broke={50051, 58147} rather than re-trying them. Did NOT touch the
  re-run-on-hidden-inputs block or the narrow-formula principle it accepted.
- Refuted hypotheses: (from cand_0001) a GLOBAL "array/formula → literal" ban regresses legacy-array +
  ordinary-formula tasks — confirmed by 50051's regression; keep the SAFE/MUST split. A hard, by-any-means
  "no cell outside range" self-check drives XML surgery that breaks recalc (58147) — must be a values check.
- High-value clusters NOT cracked: ambiguous multi-step logic-misreads (3911, 11842, 57090, 59259, 57232,
  39046, 51359, 110-2, 450-9, 30709) — grader has one intended interpretation; not prose-fixable without
  hardcoding the answer (overfits/fails gate). 56996 is an environment fault (RANDBETWEEN source, non-deterministic).
- Plateau signal: n/a (2nd iteration, +0.060 last time). If this lands, remaining ceiling is almost entirely
  the logic-misread class — next lever would be a worked "compute-from-data for a multi-step aggregation"
  example (NOT hardcoding), or accept those as an irreducible ambiguity floor.
- Focus next iteration: read this RESULT; if 50051/58147 recovered and the new clusters landed, the plateau
  is the logic-misread floor — do not spend more prose on it without a genuinely new disambiguation lever.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** REJECTED (champion unchanged) · val=0.520 Δ=-0.040 · fixed={50630, 58147} · broke={38332, 47741, 73-45, CF_11072}. — its WHOLE batch was reverted; re-introduce only the edits that did NOT break a task above, dropping/redesigning the ones that did.
